article.headline: Tripp scores 19, Wofford downs Mercer 77-66
article.description: — Corey Tripp had 19 points in Wofford's 77-66 win against Mercer on Saturday.
article.story: MACON, Ga. -- — Corey Tripp had 19 points in Wofford's 77-66 win against Mercer on Saturday. Tripp added six rebounds for the Terriers (13-12, 7-5 Southern Conference). Dillon Bailey shot 3 for 8 (2 for 5 from 3-point range) and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to add 11 points. Kyler Filewich had 10 points and shot 5 of 11 from the field and 0 for 4 from the line. The Bears (11-14, 4-8) were led by Ahmad Robinson, who recorded 16 points. Tyler Johnson added 15 points for Mercer. Alex Holt had 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
